items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Just like you take Miles and cats like that.

ctx.x: So in other words, he was into Jazz himself, too.

Yeah, he was into it. He didn't mind to play. But Prez played ungodly Jazz! You know what I mean? I mean, it was all right for what we liked. But man, Prez... Just like now. Just like you take Miles and cats like that. They play way out sometimes. It's appreciated to a musician, but a lot of people don't...the public don't dig a lot of it sometimes, you know. But that's the way Prez was playing. He was just that far ahead of time. He was way ahead of time, man. He was a little boy with short pants on playin'.…
I'm getting ahead of myself, and I didn't mean to cut you off from where you were talking about. So you were back talking about Willis Young getting the people together, teaching you scales in 1924.
